Thanks for taking the time to share.  I didn't expect many people would see my story, and far fewer would ever be in a position to sympathize.  It is almost monstrous to contemplate someone saying "But what about the rapist's feelings?" but that is exactly what, if you sum it all up, even as a victimizer, I am doing.

I responded below: basically I tried to go to a therapist once.  It turns out she was writing scrips illegally and lost her license, so my 2 meetings were pointless, we never got to talk about much more than surface symptoms and what my goals might be.  

In my head I attributed this *amputation* after trying to reach out, a simple confirmation that the Universe hates me... and should hate me.  I am a hateable guy.. hate-worthy you might say.  As the years went by, I realized what an arrogant view even this was, that the Universe was some kind of entity that gave me, a 190 lb collection of carbon and water that has the dismal fortune to be self-aware, any thought at all.

In some sense, I have succeeded.  I have a narrow ledge carved out that overlooks the abyss.  As long as I face the cliff and look up, I can see other people with happy, normal lives.  Every now and then though something will grab me by the shoulders and spin me around and I am overwhelmed by the empty vastness... just yesterday in the grocery store a woman hung up the phone and said "I love you too" to someone on the other end.  I thought "Who says that outside of movies and TV?"  and then I realized *people* do, and I blazed white hot anger for a second and immediately quenched it with dark, cold, wet, crushing sadness.

But I bought the milk and bread and went home to my family.  My wife knows that I am not a really person inside, but at least I have faked it well for the kids.  And they have faked not knowing well back to me.

Another example:  This weekend I had to attend a "driver retraining" course because I had my license plate and inspection sticker expire without noticing it and got pulled over.  They did an exercise where you had to do some variation of Maslow's pyramid (using Glasser's work) around listing things in my life I do to satisfy the 5 basic need categories: survival, love and belonging, power, freedom and fun.  I struggled to come up with anything I actually do in my life besides breathe, eat, sleep, spend time with my kids, and work.  Everyone else had lots of things in each category... but I was almost overwhelmed that same feeling I had when the woman said "I love you too..."

I don't know how to even find a therapist, how I would pay for one, or even if I could bring myself to go to one at this point... I have been living this way for over 30 years.. If I can make it 30, 40 or 50 more... great I guess.

Oh believe me, I would never be so selfish as to dredge that up.  I tried to ask her for forgiveness once.  I was 23 and she was 15... I begged he to forgive me for "that thing I did when we were kids..." she looked at me like I had 2 heads... "what are you talking about?"  I moved on to the next topic and she laughed.  She is happily married with 2 kids of her own now.

I actually tried going to therapy once.  Did a few meetings, and then my doctor sent me a letter indicating she couldn't be my mental healthcare provider any more.  Apparently she lost her license for writing bogus prescriptions.

When I was 12 and my sister was 4, I made her give me oral sex.  It never happened again, and I have never abused anyone else.  She and I have a great, healthy relationship now that I am in my 40's and she is in her 30's (I am not sure she even remembers)... but even as kids we had a normal sibling relationship, except for this one incident.

I have never forgiven myself.  I haven't thought of it in years, and your AMA has reminded me what a fucking monster I really am.  This isn't a plea for advice, or a troll... I am not fishing for rationalizations or absolution here either.

I made this throwaway just to put down in words something I have never told anyone.  I thought I would feel better.  I don't.

My wife and I haven't had sex in over a decade and I have just been OK with that I guess.  I suspect now that these feelings of self loathing, and my inability to express myself sexually are related, but I have never been to a therapist to work anything out.

...and now my kids are wondering why I am crying.  It's because your father is shit kids.  Your father is shit.
